lemmas.primary_translation: supply heat; prepare oneself for physical activity; play before a concert to build atmosphere

examples.en: the food has been heated up

definitions.text: forberede seg til en kroppslig aktivitet
definitions.translation: to prepare oneself for a physical activity

examples.no: hun varmet opp med lett jogg
examples.en: she warmed up with light jogging

examples.no: de varmet opp stemmene før de gikk inn på scenen
examples.en: they warmed up their voices before going on stage

definitions.text: spille før en konsert begynner for å få opp stemningen
definitions.translation: to play before a concert begins in order to build the atmosphere

examples.no: de skal varme opp for Deep Purple
examples.en: they will open for Deep Purple
